links.comparator_used: Original, uncalibrated published model probabilities in the external validation cohort, before intercept and slope updates
links.outcome: Calibration (calibration plot) and clinical utility (net benefit) for predicting AKI after noncardiac surgery
links.effect: All 9 models showed some miscalibration before updating; 5 of 9 were well-calibrated after intercept and slope updates. The 3 models with fair discrimination (AUROC 0.71-0.75) consistently gave a positive net benefit after recalibration. Results held in the sensitivity analysis.
links.quote: All models exhibited some miscalibration; five of the nine models were well-calibrated after intercept and slope updates.
